Flow.description: F-07 step 5 / §5.5 manual path (Phase 4, D-12). Input: CareProgram Id. Generates the onboarding Tasks from the active EM_Onboarding_Item__mdt rows — Applies_When__c (blank = always; MultiSite = more than one CareProgramSite; Has_Stipend = Per Visit Stipend set), Per_Site__c (one task per CareProgramSite, WhatId = the site), owner = the study team member holding the item's role, else EM_Onboarding_Owner_Default__mdt, else the Study owner; due = Study Awarded Date (or today) + Due_Offset_Days__c; EM_ fields stamped for F-08. Then one DocumentChecklistItem per (site × active EM_ DocumentType). Idempotent: an existing (item key @ record) or (document type @ site) is never duplicated — safe to re-run after adding sites or template rows. Ends by running EM_Onboarding_Recalc.

formulas.name: fx_OwnerId
formulas.expression: IF(FIND("|" & TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c}) & "=", {!var_TeamMap}) > 0, MID({!var_TeamMap}, FIND("|" & TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c}) & "=", {!var_TeamMap}) + LEN(TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c})) + 2, 18), IF(FIND("|" & TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c}) & "=", {!var_OwnerMap}) > 0, MID({!var_OwnerMap}, FIND("|" & TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c}) & "=", {!var_OwnerMap}) + LEN(TEXT({!L_I.Owner_Role__c})) + 2, 18), {!Get_CP.OwnerId}))
